caption: Figure 14-2. The annotation batch of the synthetic calls, before anyone annotated
alt: The Annotation batch document: progress, agreement, the strata of the sample and the end-of-utterance gaps.

regions.label: Sample
regions.note: Forty caller segments drawn from 315, stratified by campaign, month, duration and confidence, reproducible from the seed; a tenth go to a second person, blind.

regions.label: Guidelines
regions.note: The rules of a correct transcript, pinned at the commit the batch started from. The golden set's card will cite that commit.

regions.label: Agreement
regions.note: The WER between the two transcripts of the doubly annotated items. Above 5 %, the batch does not freeze.

regions.label: End of utterance
regions.note: How long the bot waits after the caller stops, from per-channel voice activity: the number a voice bot's turn-taking is tuned on.

regions.label: Invite a reviewer
regions.note: A link that lets one person play this batch's audio and write transcripts — no download, no other data — until the batch freezes.

regions.label: Freeze
regions.note: Freezing creates a golden set, so it is an approval; Check lists what still blocks it.
